title: PLCnext Control
summary: Open Linux-based controllers with Axioline F I/O.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Controllers run a real-time Linux; IEC 61131-3 programs and high-level language programs share the Global Data Space.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: No simulation profile. The Global Data Space and high-level-language programs have no counterpart in PLC Lab, which runs Structured Text in its generic IEC 61131-3 runtime. **CONCEPTUAL**.
